source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 1 同主题完形(青蒿素团队精神/爱因斯坦逃离德国/南丁格尔的灯/钟南山的勇气/鲁迅弃医从文/伟大的意义)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Discovery for the World
passages.text: When Tu Youyou won the Nobel Prize, she did not (1)____ all the honour for herself. She said that the discovery of artemisinin was a team (2)____, and that the success belonged to her country too. For many years her team had (3)____ thousands of plants, looking for one that could fight malaria. At first, nothing seemed to (4)____, and the project nearly came to a stop. But Tu Youyou refused to (5)____ defeat. She read the ancient texts again and finally found the (6)____ to the problem. By drawing out the (7)____ at a lower temperature, she got a substance that really (8)____. After more than a hundred and ninety (9)____, the team at last succeeded. Their hard work has since (10)____ countless lives around the world.

accept defeat 认输。
the answer to the problem 问题的答案。
draw out the extract 提取提取物。
a substance that worked 有效的物质。

passages.title: Einstein Leaves Germany
passages.text: By the early 1930s, Albert Einstein was already (1)____ all over the world. But in 1933 his (2)____ suddenly changed, because Hitler had come to power. After (5)____ some time in Europe, he finally took up a (6)____ as a researcher in the United States. There he (7)____ to make great discoveries in physics. People in his new town soon (8)____ to love the kind and funny scientist with the wild white hair. Although he was a (9)____, he often forgot small things, like his friends' birthdays. Yet everyone who knew him (10)____ his warm heart.

questions.explanation: famous all over the world 闻名世界。
circumstances changed 情况改变。
found the doors closed 发现门关上了。
as a consequence 结果。
spending some time 度过一些时间。
take up a position 担任职位。
continued to make discoveries 继续做出发现。
began to love 开始喜爱。
although he was a genius 虽然是天才。
remembered his warm heart 记得他温暖的心。

passages.title: The Lady with the Lamp
passages.text: Florence Nightingale grew up in a rich family, but she felt a strong (1)____ to help sick people. At that time, nursing was not (2)____ a good job for a lady, yet she (3)____ on training as a nurse. During a war she went to (4)____ for wounded soldiers in dirty hospitals. She cleaned the rooms, let in fresh (5)____, and made sure the men had warm beds. Soon far (6)____ soldiers died than before. At night she walked among the beds with a small (7)____ in her hand, so the men began to call her 'the Lady with the Lamp'. After the war she (8)____ a school to train nurses, and her ideas (9)____ hospitals all over the world. Today she is still (10)____ as the founder of modern nursing.

seen as a good job 被视为好工作。
insisted on training 坚持受训。
care for soldiers 照料士兵。
fresh air 新鲜空气。
far fewer soldiers died 死的士兵少得多。
a small lamp 一盏小灯。
founded a school 创办学校。
changed hospitals 改变了医院。
remembered as the founder 被铭记为创立者。

passages.title: A Doctor's Courage
passages.text: Zhong Nanshan is a doctor (1)____ many people in China trust deeply. He became well known during a dangerous (2)____, when a strange illness was spreading quickly. While others were (3)____, he stayed calm and told the public the (4)____ about the disease. He even (5)____ that the most serious patients be sent to his own hospital, although this put him in (6)____. His honesty and courage helped to (7)____ the outbreak. Years later, when another illness (8)____, the same trusted doctor stepped forward again, even though he was already in his (9)____. To many people, he is a fine (10)____ of what a great person should be.

a dangerous outbreak 危险的爆发。
others were frightened 别人害怕。
the truth about the disease 关于疾病的真相。
insisted that… 坚持要求。
put him in danger 使他处于危险。
control the outbreak 控制爆发。
another illness appeared 又一种疾病出现。
in his eighties 八十多岁。
a fine example 一个好榜样。

passages.title: Lu Xun Changes His Path
passages.text: Lu Xun, who is (1)____ as one of China's greatest writers, was born in 1881. As a young man he went to Japan to study (2)____, hoping to save people's lives. One day he saw a (3)____ that changed his mind. In it, a group of Chinese men did not seem to (4)____ about the suffering of their own people. From this, Lu Xun (5)____ that the real problem in China was not in people's bodies but in their (6)____. So he decided to (7)____ medical school and become a writer instead. He believed that powerful (8)____ could wake people up. His first famous short (9)____, A Madman's Diary, soon got published. Through his pen, he tried to make his country (10)____ and stronger.

study medicine 学医。
saw a photo 看到一张照片。

concluded that… 得出结论。
in their minds 在他们心里/精神上。

a short story 短篇小说。

passages.title: What Makes a Person Great
passages.text: What does it really (1)____ to be a great person? Many of us think first of famous (2)____, writers or leaders. But true greatness may have little to do with (3)____. A great person does not need to (7)____ the whole world. A teacher who gives up free time to help a (8)____ student can be great in a quiet way. So can a parent who (9)____ hard for a family. never giving up 永不放弃。
